  WHY: The resolver then receives SIGPIPE on its next stderr write, which terminates the resolver with exit code 141 rather than letting it run to its intended exit code; the "Assemble failure evidence" step then fingerprints and names an incomplete failure.

The existing `RUNTIME_DIR` setup earlier in the workflow makes this unlikely in practice, but the redirect is unconditional — there is no guard that falls back to unredirected execution when the capture path is unavailable.
